name: Innsbruck Christmas Market
beschreibung: Innsbruck's historic old town transforms into a sea of lights. The Christkindlmarkt around the Goldene Dachl is one of the most beautiful in Austria. Artisan crafts, mulled wine, roasted chestnuts, and traditional Tyrolean delicacies create an evocative festive atmosphere.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Christkindlmarkt in the historic old town of Innsbruck – Christmas magic in front of the Goldene Dachl.
